scope: The surviving east and west sugar silos and old lime kiln at the former Halfweg Sugar Factory, now SugarCity.

originalReview.notes: Tasja’s exact 2008 Qualla file was released in its first description by the photographer. Wikimedia account rename 122233026 matches Tasja to Tasja~commonswiki. The image establishes cladding, dark diamond panels, and the tapered industrial shaft and upper platform. Construction equipment is outside scope.

quallaSearch.notes: Started with Tasja’s exact public-domain Qualla original, verified against the original image and archived account rename. The current elevation survey and architecture record establish the twin towers and kiln.
